dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Tell me what has been happening and when you first noticed the problem.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: For about two days I have had a feeling of tightness in my chest. It is not constant, but it worries me when it happens.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Do you notice it more during exercise, while resting, or at any particular time?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: It is more noticeable when I climb stairs. Yesterday I also became slightly short of breath after walking quickly upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had a fever, cough, dizziness, or pain spreading into your arm or jaw?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No fever and no cough. I have not felt dizzy, and the discomfort has not spread into my arm or jaw.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Do you smoke cigarettes or use any nicotine products?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I do not smoke and I do not use nicotine.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. I want to check your blood pressure, oxygen level, heart rate, and listen to your heart and lungs before deciding what comes next.
